name: select
title: Select
description: A dropdown for choosing one option — trigger with value and chevron, grouped scrollable popup, full keyboard navigation, animated enter/exit.

meta.whenToUse: Choosing a single value from a fixed, known set — fonts, timezones, statuses — especially long/grouped lists.
meta.whenNotToUse: Boolean on/off (Switch), few inline options (radios), multi-select, or free-text/async search (combobox).
